original_question: What is the deformation theory of G2-instantons on asymptotically locally conical G2-manifolds, how does it relate to the deformation theory of Calabi-Yau monopoles on asymptotically conical Calabi-Yau 3-folds, and what is the image of the natural projection from the moduli space of G2-instantons on an ALC G2-manifold to the space of Calabi-Yau monopoles on the asymptotic Calabi-Yau cone?
target_in_paper: Section 4.4(c) (Open problems): the ALC open problem asking for a deformation theory of G2-instantons on ALC G2-manifolds, its relation with the deformation theory of Calabi-Yau monopoles on AC Calabi-Yau 3-folds, and the image of the asymptotic projection to Calabi-Yau monopoles on the end cone. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the exact ALC open problem in the paper: it asks about deformation theory of G2-instantons on ALC G2-manifolds, its relation to the deformation theory of Calabi-Yau monopoles on AC Calabi-Yau 3-folds, and the image of a natural projection to monopoles on the Calabi-Yau cone at infinity. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))
missing_details: The paper frames this as an open problem in Section 4.4(c), not as a theorem or conjecture already proved. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))

To be stand-alone, the ALC geometry should be specified using the end data from Section 4.1: a U(1)-bundle π:Σ→Γ, an asymptotic model g_{φ∞}=dr^2+m^2η_∞^2+r^2π^*g_5 with m>0, a compact set K⊂X, and a diffeomorphism p:(1,∞)×Σ→X\K satisfying the decay condition (4.1); Proposition 8 then identifies dr^2+r^2g_5 on (1,∞)×Γ as Calabi-Yau. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))

The projection is only motivated for instantons whose curvature has a U(1)-invariant asymptotic model A_∞=a+mΦ⊗η_∞ on the ALC end, with p^*F_A asymptotic to F_{A_∞}; your draft does not state these hypotheses. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))

Proposition 9 is the precise bridge to Calabi-Yau monopoles: under the preceding asymptotic hypothesis, the pair (a,Φ) is a Calabi-Yau monopole on the cone (1,∞)×Γ. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))

The target of the projection in Section 4.4(c) is the space of Calabi-Yau monopoles on the Calabi-Yau cone at the end of the ALC manifold; the reference to AC Calabi-Yau 3-folds concerns a related deformation theory, not the codomain of that particular map. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))

The paper does not fix a Banach-space/gauge-fixing set-up for the moduli problem here, and it does not specify a particular structure group in Section 4.4(c); globally, the article works with a principal G-bundle with G compact and semisimple. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))

If you want the question to match the paper's wording, it should ask for the local geometry of the moduli space, that is, deformation theory, rather than for a full classification or existence theory of all ALC G2-instantons. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))
refined_question: Let (X,φ) be an asymptotically locally conical G2-manifold in the sense of Section 4.1, with end modeled by a U(1)-bundle π:Σ→Γ and diffeomorphism p:(1,∞)×Σ→X\K, where the base cone C=(1,∞)×Γ is Calabi-Yau and η_∞ is Hermitian-Yang-Mills. For a G2-instanton A on a principal G-bundle over X, with G compact semisimple, whose curvature admits a U(1)-invariant asymptotic model A_∞=a+mΦ⊗η_∞ on the end, in the sense that p^*F_A is asymptotic to F_{A_∞}, develop the local deformation theory of A, make precise its relation to the deformation theory of the induced Calabi-Yau monopole (a,Φ) on the end cone C, and, as suggested in the paper, to Calabi-Yau monopoles on AC Calabi-Yau 3-folds; then determine the image of the resulting asymptotic-limit projection A↦(a,Φ) from the moduli space of such G2-instantons on X to the space of Calabi-Yau monopoles on C. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))
justification: The draft is targeting Section 4.4(c) almost exactly in substance. I tightened it by importing the end-geometry and asymptotic-connection notation from Section 4.1 and equation (4.3), because Section 4.4(c) presupposes that context; and I used Proposition 9 to spell out what the paper leaves implicit, namely that the "projection map" is naturally read as the asymptotic map sending a G2-instanton with U(1)-invariant end model A_∞=a+mΦ⊗η_∞ to the Calabi-Yau monopole (a,Φ) on the Calabi-Yau cone. This last point is an inference from the nearby context, supported by Proposition 9, not a separately stated equivalence in the paper. ([discovery.ucl.ac.uk](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/10067480/1/1812.11867v1.pdf))
